note: The Institut d'émission d'outre-mer (IEOM), which issues the CFP franc of French Polynesia, New Caledonia and Wallis and Futuna, in its 2008 annual report: since the euro's introduction on 1 January 1999 the franc's parity has been 8.38 euros for 1,000 F CFP. The parity has no finite decimal, so its rate against the dollar is the euro's times 1,000 / 8.38, written to six places, half to even. Read 2026-10-30.

sources.title: Institut d'émission d'outre-mer, Rapport annuel 2008
sources.said: la parité du F CFP est devenue, par simple conversion, de 8,38 euros pour 1 000 F CFP
